Hi Lydia — thanks for the clear asks. Below is our canonical response for the questionnaire items you highlighted. I’ve tried to keep answers short for the doc and included the evidence we can attach. If you’d like a diagram or console screenshots we can produce those as well (see links at the end).

Q1) Do customer payloads leave the selected processing region?
Answer: No for primary processing and storage when a customer selects a regional endpoint. For Stratus (US) the following applies: runtime processing (inference) and primary ephemeral storage remain in the selected region (us-west-2 or us-east-1 depending on your choice). We do not replicate request/response payloads to other regions for normal operation.

Exceptions and notes:
- Global control-plane metadata (tenant ID, billing metering counters, and anonymized performance metrics) is available in the control plane that resides in the US. This metadata does NOT contain full prompt/response text.
- Our asynchronous background backups and cold-storage snapshots are configurable by tenant. Default backup snapshot retention is 90 days and backups are stored in the same region by default. If your contract requires region-locked backups we will include a region-lock addendum and bind snapshots to your selected region.

Evidence we can provide:
- Export of the storage-class / bucket tags showing region binding (screenshot & CSV)
- Confirmation of bucket ARNs and replication settings (non-replicated by default)
- Short recorded demo of launching a regional endpoint in the Stratus tenant with region set to us-west-2 (video clip).

Q2) Tenant-wide erase — end-to-end timeline (primary store, caches, backups, audit trails)
Answer (default hosted flow):
- Immediate: On deletion request we mark tenant objects for purge and remove primary objects from the live store within 24 hours (typically under 4 hours for standard workloads). This includes request/response artifacts retained for debug or quality monitoring.
- Backup & snapshot purge: We initiate background purge jobs for eligible backup snapshots. Standard backup retention is 90 days; once purge is requested we schedule snapshot retention override and attempt expedited deletion. Expedited deletion of backups typically completes within 7–14 days depending on snapshot lifecycle and cloud-provider immutable window.
- Caches & KV stores: Inference KV/prefix caches are invalidated synchronously and removed within the immediate purge operation (minutes).
- Audit logs & billing records: We retain minimal billing/usage metadata for 24 months to satisfy accounting and SLA reporting. Billing records do not contain full prompt/response content. If you require a shorter billing-record retention window, this must be contractually agreed and may impact auditability and billing reconciliation.

Enterprise SLA options (negotiated):
- 72-hour full-erase SLA: possible with Dedicated commitment and a short-term audit window; requires a small operational fee and pre-agreed process.
- Region-locked immediate backup purge: available if contractually required and included in Private/Dedicated offering.

Evidence we can provide for the erase flow:
- Purge runbook excerpt (PDF) showing steps and internal SLAs.
- Example purge job logs (redacted) showing object deletion stages.
- A timeline diagram showing primary deletion, cache invalidation, and backup purge windows.

Additional implementation notes:
- Cryptographic keys: Customer data is encrypted at rest with tenant-specific envelope keys. For hosted tenants, keys are managed in our KMS; we offer customer-managed keys (CMK) for enterprise customers. When CMK is used and you request deletion we will rotate/revoke keys to make prior encrypted data cryptographically inaccessible; this is an accepted pattern to expedite effective data destruction for backups.
- Forensics/eDiscovery: If a legal hold is required, that supersedes delete requests; legal holds must be submitted through your account manager.

Next steps / ask for Stratus:
- Confirm whether you want us to bind backups to us-west-2 exclusively (we can add a region-lock addendum).
- If a shorter backup purge window or 72-hour erase SLA is required, let us know and I’ll escalate for commercial approval.

Attachments included for your packet: purge_runbook_excerpt.pdf, sample_purge_log_redacted.txt, region_binding_screenshot.png

Links for quick reference:
- Hosted data lifecycle: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/hosted-data-lifecycle
- Stratus evidence package (temporary): https://redwood.example.com/sq/stratus-2026

Kimberly — please note the CMK option and commercial implications; we may need pricing confirmation if they want the 72-hour SLA.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
